plugins.name: luxbnb-guesty
plugins.description: Guesty assistant for the LuxBnB property-management team: reservations, calendar, inbox, tasks, and scheduled reports. Get started: (1) Use a ChatGPT Project with a folder, preferably in the desktop app. (2) Add the LuxBnB Guesty MCP connector (see README). (3) In that project, ask to use the guesty-onboarding skill. (4) Then use interview-and-dashboard-setup in the same chat for reports. (5) Keep that chat for later changes. Put statements in the project folder under reports/statements/, not only in the chat.
